# T003.1 — Add .NET 10 web host

## Summary

Added an independently runnable, empty ASP.NET Core host beside the unchanged .NET Framework 4.8 application. No legacy routes or behavior have been migrated.

## Changes (files and why)

- `DescopeSampleApp.Core/DescopeSampleApp.Core.csproj` — SDK-style `Microsoft.NET.Sdk.Web` application targeting `net10.0`, with no additional package dependencies.
- `DescopeSampleApp.Core/Program.cs` — minimal builder/build/run pipeline; removed the template's sample `/` endpoint so no migrated route is implied.
- `DescopeSampleApp.Core/appsettings.json`, `DescopeSampleApp.Core/appsettings.Development.json`, `DescopeSampleApp.Core/Properties/launchSettings.json` — generated standalone configuration and local launch profiles; no credentials or legacy configuration copied.
- `DescopeSampleApp.sln` — includes the new host in existing Debug/Release Any CPU configurations, without changing the two existing projects or adding unrelated solution platforms.
- This progress note documents the scope and validation.

## Decisions (rationale and sources)

- Use side-by-side independent hosting, without proxying or legacy route removal, as specified by the approved plan T003 and the run goal. The old `System.Web` host and `Directory.Build.props` bridge remain untouched. No YARP, IIS or deployment changes.
- Target the installed .NET 10 SDK (`dotnet --list-sdks`: 10.0.401 and 10.0.402) and `net10.0`. Microsoft Learn lists .NET 10 as LTS through November 2028: https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/core/releases-and-support (checked 2026-10-20); the assessment records the support-policy date 2028-11-14. New project, not an in-place retarget of the net48 host; no shared-library TFM removed.
- Keep only the generated configuration structure; defer controllers, Razor Pages, authentication, serializer decisions, shared code, health endpoints and route matching to their planned tasks. No intermediate-version breaking changes were encountered in an empty new project.

## Validation (commands and results)

- `msbuild -restore -p:RestorePackagesConfig=true -p:Configuration=Release -m -nologo -v:minimal` — PASS, exit 0; legacy app, legacy characterization tests and new net10 host built. Existing NU1902 (two jQuery advisories) and MSB3247 binding conflict remain; no new host warnings observed.
- `dotnet test --no-build -c Release` — PASS, exit 0; **23 passed, 0 failed, 0 skipped** (unchanged net48 suite). New host tests are planned for T004.1.
- Lint — none configured.
- Standalone smoke: `dotnet run --no-build --no-launch-profile -c Release --project DescopeSampleApp.Core/DescopeSampleApp.Core.csproj --urls http://127.0.0.1:<temporary-port>` started independently; local GET `/` returned expected 404, confirming no routes yet. Temporary loopback port and host process cleaned up; no external service accessed.

## Follow-ups and risks

- T004.1 must add WebApplicationFactory coverage for the host; the current 23 tests characterize only the legacy application. A 404 from this empty host does not demonstrate legacy HTTP equivalence.
- Preserve the legacy NU1902/MSB3247 warnings for their separately scoped follow-up; no packages, warnings or tests were suppressed.
